cards.audioText: Your call sign is CCA985 from Wuhan to Frankfurt, you are at Bay 221, with information H, contact Wuhan Delivery for airway clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是国航985，从武汉飞往法兰克福，你现在在221号停机位，收到通播H，联系武汉放行，请求航路许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CCA985, bay 221, information H, request ATC clearance to Frankfurt.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，国航985，221号停机位，收到通播H，请求飞往法兰克福的管制许可。

cards.audioText: CCA985, Wuhan Delivery, cleared to Frankfurt via flight planned route, runway 04, follow ZF-01D departure, initially climb to 1500m on QNH, cruising level 9500m, departure frequency 119.35.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航985，武汉放行，可以经由计划航路飞往法兰克福，跑道04，按照ZF-01离场，初始爬升至修正海压1500米，巡航高度9500米，离场频率119.35。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Frankfurt via flight planned route, runway 04, follow ZF-01D departure, initially climb to 1500m on QNH, cruising level 9500m, departure frequency 119.35. CCA985.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以经由计划航路飞往法兰克福，跑道04，按照ZF-01离场，初始爬升至修正海压1500米，巡航高度9500米，离场频率119.35，国航985。

cards.audioText: CCA985, read back correct, your slot time is 1435, contact Wuhan Ground on 121.85.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航985，复诵正确，你的离场时间是14:35，联系武汉地面121.85。
cards.referenceText:
Slot time 1435, 121.85. CCA985.
（注：只要是管制员给出的离场时间（限制或许可时间），飞行员必须复诵。如果是随口告知的参考时间（非指令），可以不复诵，但谨慎起见，复诵更安全）

cards.audioText: During pushback you have a small avionics problem, you wish to remain on taxiway Z4 for approximately 5 minutes, inform Wuhan Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: 在推出过程中，你的航空电子设备出现了一些小问题，你希望在Z4滑行道上停留大约5分钟，告知武汉地面
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA985, request remain on taxiway Z4 for about 5mins due a small avionics problem.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，国航985，由于航空电子设备出现小问题，请求在Z4滑行道停留大约5分钟。

cards.audioText:
Roger, CCA985, advise when you are ready.
[You decided that the maintenance are needed before departure, tell Wuhan Ground you want to return to Gate 221 to have the plane checked by the engineers.]
cards.audioTextZh:
收到，国航985，准备好后告知。
[你决定，在离场前，需要对飞机进行维修，告诉武汉地面，你想返回到221号停机位，让机务检查飞机]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA985, request return to Gate 221 to have the plane checked by the engineers.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，国航985，请求返回221号停机位，让机务检查飞机。

cards.audioText: CCA985, Gate 221 will be occupied by another aircraft in a minute, standby a while, I will assign you another gate.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航985, 221号停机位会在1分钟后被另一架飞机占用，稍等下，我会给你分配别的机位。

cards.audioText: The engineers have fixed the avionic problem, request Wuhan Ground for engine start up.
cards.audioTextZh: 工程师解决了航空电子设备的问题，联系武汉地面，请求启动发动机
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA985, avionic problem fixed, request start-up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，国航985，航空电子设备问题解决，请求启动发动机。

cards.audioText: CCA985, your slot time is expired, your new slot time is 1615, start up at own discretion.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航985，你的离场时间已经过期，你的新的离场时间是16:15，自行决定开车时间。
cards.referenceText: 1615, start up at own discretion, CCA985.

cards.audioText: Now you have completed the engine start up procedures, call Wuhan Ground for taxiway instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在，你完成了发动机启动程序，呼叫武汉地面，请求滑行指令
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，国航985，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: CCA985, taxi via taxiway C, M, A to holding point runway 04. Hold short of Z4.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航985，经由滑行道C、M、A，滑行至跑道04，在Z4等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via taxiway C, M, A to holding point runway 04. Hold short of Z4. CCA985.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由滑行道C、M、A，滑行至跑道04，在Z4等待，国航985。

cards.audioText: You are now at holding point of runway 04, you are ready for takeoff, call Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在在跑道04等待点，你准备好起飞了，呼叫武汉塔台
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA985, holding point of runway 04, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，国航985，跑道04等待点，准备好离场了。

cards.audioText: CCA985, surface wind 070 degrees, 3 m/s, cleared for takeoff runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航985，地面风070度，3米每秒，可以起飞，跑道04。

cards.audioText: Shortly after airborne, smoke is coming from the avionics bay, make a distress call to Wuhan Tower and ask for immediate return for landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 离地不久，烟雾从电子设备舱冒出，向武汉塔台做遇险通话，请求立即返场着陆
cards.referenceText: Mayday Mayday Mayday, Wuhan Tower, CCA985, request immediate return for landing due avionics bay smoke.
cards.referenceTextZh: Mayday，Mayday，Mayday，武汉塔台，国航985，由于烟雾从电子设备舱冒出，请求立即返场着陆。

cards.audioText: Tell Tower you want to level off at 600m and remain on the Tower frequency.
cards.audioTextZh: 告诉塔台，你希望在600米改平，并保持塔台频率
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA985, request level off at 600m and remain on the Tower frequency.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，国航985，请求在600米改平，并保持塔台频率。

cards.audioText: Tell Wuhan Tower you want to fly a right hand circuit for immediate landing runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: 告诉武汉塔台，你要飞右起落，并立即降落04跑道。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA985, request a right hand circuit for immediate landing runway 04.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，国航985，请求飞右起落，并立即降落04跑道。

cards.audioText: CCA985, maintain 600m, turn right to join the downwind for runway 04, report when turning base.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航985，保持600米，右转加入三边，跑道04，进入四边后报。
cards.referenceText: Maintain 600m, turn right to join the downwind for runway 04, report when turning base. CCA985.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持600米，右转加入三边，跑道04，进入四边后报，国航985。

cards.audioText: The smoke situation cannot be controlled, request emergency services upon landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 烟雾情况不受控制，在着陆后请求紧急服务
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA985, request emergency services upon landing due the smoke situation cannot be controlled.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，国航985，由于烟雾情况不受控制，在着陆后请求紧急服务。
